content: trellis .github governance + workflow set: verbatim copies from templates/l5-toolkit/github (dependabot.yml cooldown, labels.yml, pull_request_template.md, ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*, sync-labels.yml); publish.yml + auto-merge.yml adapted from seeds/.github/workflows. Adaptations: (1) ci.yml = bun install -> bun run check:all (VERBATIM CI-parity contract; check:all already covers coverage/lint/typecheck/agents/size/debt/dups/deps) -> test:ci -> report:test-timing + report:quality-metrics summaries -> upload test-results/junit.xml + coverage/lcov.info; (2) publish.yml references @os-eco/trellis-cli and asserts VERSION sync vs src/index.ts (NOT src/version.ts — trellis keeps VERSION in index.ts per SPEC §13); (3) ci.yml uses report:test-timing/report:quality-metrics so those npm aliases were ADDED to package.json (warren naming, -> scripts/report-*.ts); (4) once .github/workflows/+ci.yml existed the redundant --known-missing .github/workflows[/ci.yml] flags were PRUNED from check:agents; (5) bug_report.yml <cli> -> trellis. Validation: all 9 YAML files parse via js-yaml; full CI path (check:all, test:ci, both reports) exits 0 and emits the two artifacts.

description: Two operational snags hit during trellis-1e66 and their resolutions
resolution: bun install --frozen-lockfile before any gate; ignore the biome schema info; for large multiline replacements the edit tool may reject a block python3 confirms matches byte-for-byte — fall back to a python heredoc script
